policy: Payloads use .txt suffixes for inspection and hash preservation. Only listed literal absolute machine-local root strings are replaced. Original hashes embedded in derivative content are intentionally unchanged and refer to original raw source bytes, not transformed files. No source/report edits or reruns are implied.

placeholderRoles.<SCRATCH_ROOT>/: Generic original absolute scratch-directory prefix; retained only as a role placeholder in inspection copies

omissions: Physical consumer package copies and second reproducible artifact copy; exact hashes are retained in original freezes/inventories.

Historical negative-case compiler resolution-trace dumps and CONTROL-PROBE raw trace duplication; selected reports retain diagnostics and graph hashes, and exact harness/spec/control sources are included.
Upstream/dependency/compiler library payloads; hashes remain in type reports and pinned graph evidence.
Historical failed upstream harness and diagnostic log; preserved in original scratch freeze, explained in original README.
Build stdout and routine lint logs; original observations/format records and freezes retain their provenance.
